overview_description.description:
zPREDICTA’s bio-simulation technology combines biology with automation and computation to automate drug development. zPREDICTA's  bio-simulation platform enables pharma to rapidly identify drug candidates that will be effective in patients.

r-Organ is a set of next generation 3D culture models that provide 1-to-1 reconstruction of human tissue microenvironment in an organ- and disease-specific manner allowing accurate prediction of drug response. Utilizing r-Organ technology, zPREDICTA is mapping cellular behavior in response to anticancer drugs.
